metadata.name: Event Triggers
metadata.summary: Timer, SMS, and email event providers as flow trigger nodes

nodeTypes.label: Timer / Schedule
nodeTypes.config_schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","title":"Timer provider config","type":"object","required":["enabled"],"properties":{"enabled":{"type":"boolean","description":"Whether the timer source is active"},"timezone":{"type":"string","description":"IANA timezone for evaluation (default UTC)"},"default_delay_seconds":{"type":"number","description":"Default delay in seconds before the timer fires (default 30)"},"persistence_key_prefix":{"type":"string","description":"Override prefix for persisted scheduled entries"}},"additionalProperties":false}

nodeTypes.label: SMS (Twilio)
